content.en: Place the board and five Cave Entrance tiles. Shuffle the Treasure and Trap cards into the Expedition deck. Each player takes a matching Explorer, Chest, Continue card, and Return card. Keep all Gems in the central reserve.
content.zh: 摆好游戏板和 5 个洞穴入口牌。将宝藏牌与陷阱牌洗成远征牌堆。每位玩家拿同色探险家、宝箱、继续牌和返回牌。所有宝石放在中央储备区。

content.en: Reveal the top Expedition card and add it to the cave path. A Treasure card pays Rubies to everyone still in the cave; a first Trap of a type is harmless; a Relic in the optional variant simply stays on the path.
content.zh: 翻开远征牌并接在洞穴路径末端。宝藏牌给仍在洞穴的玩家分红；某种陷阱第一次出现时没有效果；可选遗迹变体中的遗迹牌只留在路径上。

label.en: It is a Relic variant card

content.en: Take the number of Rubies shown on the card. Divide them equally among all Explorers still in the cave. Put any remainder on the Treasure card. Your new Rubies stay beside your Chest until you safely return.
content.zh: 从储备区拿出牌面数量的红宝石，平均分给仍在洞穴中的探险家。除不尽的红宝石留在宝藏牌上。刚拿到的红宝石放在宝箱旁，安全返回前都可能失去。

alt.en: A Treasure 9 is split among five explorers, leaving four Rubies on the card
alt.zh: 宝藏 9 由五名探险家平分，每人 1 枚，余下 4 枚留在牌上

content.en: If this Trap type has appeared only once this round, nothing happens and the expedition continues to the decision step. If the same Trap appears for the second time, everyone still in the cave flees and loses all Gems gathered this round.
content.zh: 如果这种陷阱本回合只出现过一次，没有额外效果，进入决定步骤。如果同一种陷阱第二次出现，仍在洞穴中的所有人立刻逃回营地，失去本回合拿到但还没存进宝箱的宝石。

alt.en: The second identical Trap ends the expedition and wipes out unbanked Gems
alt.zh: 第二张相同陷阱会结束远征，并让未存入宝箱的宝石归零

title.en: Leave the Relic on the Path

content.en: In the optional Relic variant, a Relic card gives no immediate Gems. Leave it on the cave path, then continue to the simultaneous decision step.
content.zh: 在可选遗迹变体中，遗迹牌不会立刻产生宝石。把它留在洞穴路径上，然后进入同时决定步骤。

content.en: Every Explorer still in the cave secretly chooses one card. Reveal all choices at the same time. Continue keeps you in the cave for another card; Return sends you safely to camp.
content.zh: 仍在洞穴中的每位探险家暗中选 1 张决定牌，然后同时亮牌。选继续就留在洞穴里翻下一张；选返回就安全回到营地。

alt.en: Explorers secretly choose Continue or Return and reveal simultaneously
alt.zh: 探险家暗中选择继续或返回，再同时亮牌

content.en: Move your Explorer to camp. Collect the Rubies left on Treasure cards; if several players return together, share those Rubies equally and leave any remainder on the path. Then put all Rubies you gathered this round into your Chest. Five Rubies may be exchanged for one Diamond at any time.
content.zh: 把探险家移回营地。收走宝藏牌上留下的红宝石；如果多人同时返回，就由他们平分，除不尽的留在路径上。然后把你本回合拿到的所有红宝石放进宝箱。任何时候都可以用 5 枚红宝石换 1 颗钻石。

title.en: Only a Solo Return Claims Relics
title.zh: 只有独自返回才能拿遗迹

content.en: If exactly one player returns, that player takes every Relic on the path and keeps them safely under the Chest. If two or more players return together, nobody takes the Relics. Relics score their printed values at the end and cannot be lost.
content.zh: 如果只有 1 名玩家返回，该玩家拿走路径上的所有遗迹，安全放在宝箱下方。如果至少 2 名玩家同时返回，没人能拿遗迹。遗迹在终局按牌面分值计分，拿到后不会遗失。

alt.en: A solo returner claims the Relic and leftover Rubies; simultaneous returners do not claim Relics
alt.zh: 独自返回者拿走遗迹和路径余宝；多人同时返回时不能拿遗迹

title.en: A Duplicate Trap Ends the Round

content.en: Everyone still in the cave returns to camp empty-handed. Remove the second identical Trap from the game. Rubies left on Treasure cards return to the reserve; Relics still on the path are removed in the Relic variant.
content.zh: 仍在洞穴中的所有人空手回到营地。从游戏中移除第二张相同陷阱。宝藏牌上留下的红宝石回到储备区；使用遗迹变体时，路径上仍留下的遗迹也移出游戏。

content.en: Remove the Cave Entrance tile for the round that just ended. Shuffle all revealed Expedition cards back into the deck, except the removed duplicate Trap; in the Relic variant, also remove Relics left on the path. Start the next round with the next entrance.
content.zh: 移除刚结束回合对应的洞穴入口牌。把翻开的远征牌洗回牌堆，但被移除的重复陷阱除外；使用遗迹变体时，路径上没被带走的遗迹也移出游戏。用下一个入口开始新回合。

content.en: After five rounds, score the Gems in your Chest: each Ruby is 1 point and each Diamond is 5 points. In the Relic variant, add the printed values of your secured Relics. The highest total wins; tied players share the victory.
content.zh: 五回合后，计算宝箱中的宝石：每枚红宝石 1 分，每颗钻石 5 分。使用遗迹变体时，再加上已安全带回的遗迹牌面分值。总分最高者获胜；平手则共同获胜。
